output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes all three issues: (1) apostrophe removal before regex matching, (2) proper word-boundary aware truncation matching the docstring spec, and (3) correcting DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH from 40 to 50 to satisfy the test-encoded spec. All changes align with the documented algorithm in the docstring. Tests were not modified as requested. The implementations are clean, well-commented, and handle edge cases (long first words, exact-fit slugs, empty results). The DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH change is necessary since the tests (which encode the content team's spec) expect behavior consistent with a higher default.
